study: Cached encoder continuation on previously unevaluated real speech sources

selection.order: ascending dataset row index within clean then other, skip used speaker groups and audio longer than 29 seconds using public duration only

fit_objective: Mean per-speaker mean clipped WER plus 0.01 times actual process CPU seconds for encode + greedy + selected continuation; choose lower threshold on ties
CI: 95% paired speaker-cluster bootstrap, 4000 resamples with seed2701; repetitions averaged inside utterance before speaker resampling
superiority_gate: Actual transcript identity for same-policy arms; CPU and wall saving intervals must both exclude zero. Strong fixed baseline additionally requires WER upper difference <= 0.01 and CPU saving upper bound < 0.
all_costs: Include audio decoding, features, encoder, every decoder call, gate, output serialization/readback and digest; report model load and fitting separately
scope: Frozen neural natural-speech-to-text generation with a fitted continuation threshold; no neural parameter update, speech synthesis, original Hepta neuron or general multimodal LLM claim
stopping_rule: One frozen source split and gate; retain all errors, complete every predeclared arm/repetition, do not tune on held-out outputs
